mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wms_inventory_reservation WHERE fulfillment_order_id = #{fulfillmentOrderId} AND reservation_status = 'RESERVED' ORDER BY inventory_id, id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_inventory_reservation SET reservation_status = #{to}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW(), released_time = CASE WHEN #{to} = 'RELEASED' THEN NOW() ELSE released_time END, shipped_time = CASE WHEN #{to} = 'SHIPPED' THEN NOW() ELSE shipped_time END WHERE id = #{id} AND reservation_status = #{from} AND version = #{version}
